{{one source |date=May 2024}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''normed algebra''' ''A'' is an [[algebra over a field]] which has a sub-multiplicative [[norm (mathematics)|norm]]:
: <math>\forall x,y\in A\qquad \|xy\|\le\|x\|\|y\|.</math>

Some authors require it to have a [[Algebra_over_a_field#Unital_algebras|multiplicative identity]] {{itco|1{{sub|''A''}}}} such that ‖{{itco|1{{sub|''A''}}}}‖ = 1.
